record.question: To be like a cat on hot bricks
options: To have a high opinion of self
To reveal a secret by mistake
record.explanation: Answer A: To be very nervous. Like a cat on hot bricks means very nervous/restless (A). Independent check: “Like a cat on hot bricks” describes someone very nervous or restless.
